title: Tee-recovery for review-fix loops
body: When a review lens or a coverage-sweep iteration ingests command output (`git diff`, `npm test`, etc.), feed the agent a compressed/filtered view by default but tee the full output to a recoverable artifact. If a later iteration's agent flags missing context ("the truncated log doesn't show line N"), the loop hands it the full saved output instead of re-running the command or asking the human. RTK already implements this with `tee.mode = "failures"` — we can either invoke RTK directly (see `COMP-RTK-INTEROP`) or implement a thin equivalent in `lib/review-lenses.js`. Cuts the "sorry, can you give me more context" round-trip that currently shows up in long fix loops.
